slides.title: Northwind grew revenue 18% in Q3 while holding margins flat
slides.subtitle: Quarterly business review for the executive team

slides.title: Q3 beat plan on revenue and retention, but cash conversion slipped
slides.takeaway: Growth is coming from existing accounts; collections are the main operational risk going into Q4.

slides.title: Enterprise drove two thirds of the revenue increase
takeaways: Mid-market growth steady at 7% per quarter
No single account above 6% of revenue

slides.title: Three operational issues explain most of the margin pressure
bullets: Freight costs rose 11% after the carrier contract reset in July
Onboarding headcount grew ahead of new bookings
Warranty claims normalised after the Q2 spike
slides.callout: Fixing freight and renewal discounting recovers roughly 1.1 points of margin.

slides.title: The renewal discount problem is a policy gap, not a pricing gap

left.heading: What we see
bullets: Reps approve discounts above 10% without review
Multi-year deals receive the deepest cuts
Win rates did not improve with deeper discounts

right.heading: What we propose
bullets: Price multi-year commitments on volume, not term
Monthly discount report to regional leads

slides.title: North and West regions account for most of the discount leakage
slides.takeaway: Two regions drive 78% of leakage, so the fix can start there.

slides.title: The plan recovers margin within two quarters

slides.quote: We never lost a renewal on price last year. We lost two on onboarding speed.
slides.title: Customers are telling us speed matters more than price
The new deal desk flow adds one approval step for large discounts
bullets: Rep submits discount request in CRM
Deal desk responds within one business day
Approvals above 20% go to the CFO
